cohort: A 34-year-old pregnant woman in her 34th week of gestation with uncontrolled asthma.
finding: Tracheal tumors can be misdiagnosed as asthma, and clinicians should consider coexisting diseases, including tracheal tumors, when asthma control is poor.
mod_finding: An urgent Caesarean section was performed due to rapidly progressing respiratory failure in the pregnant woman.
